name: BotGate – AI Crawler Control
author: Anil

sections.description:
AI companies send crawlers to read websites, some to train models and some to answer questions in AI search. BotGate lets you decide which of them may read your site, from one screen under Settings → BotGate.

AI bot control

  • A table of known AI crawlers: name, company, purpose (AI training, AI search or user request) and an Allow / Block switch.
  • Three one-click presets: Block training, allow search (recommended), Block all AI bots and Allow all AI bots. Fine-tune any bot after picking one.
  • Rules are added to WordPress’s virtual robots.txt through the robots_txt filter, between # BEGIN BotGate and # END BotGate. BotGate never edits a file on your server.
  • A live preview shows exactly which rules will be added before you save.
  • Conflict detection warns you when a physical robots.txt file overrides the virtual one, when the site discourages search engines, when WordPress is installed in a subdirectory, or when plain permalinks are used.
  • A Site Health test (Tools → Site Health) reports the same conflicts.

llms.txt generator

  • Publishes a Markdown file at /llms.txt with your site name, a short description, the pages you choose and the latest posts from the categories you choose.
  • Preview the file before saving.
  • Regenerates automatically when you publish, update or delete content.
  • Password-protected, private and draft content is never included.

Privacy

The free version makes no external requests and does no tracking.

Known bots in this release

GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User (OpenAI) · ClaudeBot, Claude-User (Anthropic) · Google-Extended (Google) · PerplexityBot (Perplexity) · CCBot (Common Crawl) · Bytespider (ByteDance) · Applebot-Extended (Apple) · Meta-ExternalAgent (Meta).

The list ships with the plugin and is updated with each release. Developers can change it with the botgate_bots filter.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the anilsuwal-botgate folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Go to Settings → BotGate. The recommended preset (block training, allow search) is active by default.
  4. Open the llms.txt tab, choose the pages and categories to list, and click Save and regenerate.
sections.faq:
Does robots.txt actually stop AI bots?

robots.txt is a request. The major AI companies say their crawlers respect it, but a bot can ignore it.

I have a robots.txt file in my site root. Will BotGate work?

No. A physical file is served by your web server before WordPress runs, so the virtual robots.txt (and BotGate’s rules) is never used. BotGate warns you about this. Delete or rename the file, or copy the BotGate rules from the preview into it.

Does it work with Yoast SEO, Rank Math or All in One SEO?

BotGate is built to work alongside them. Those plugins also use the robots_txt filter; BotGate adds its block after theirs (priority 20) and never duplicates it.

Why does /llms.txt return a 404?

Go to Settings → Permalinks and click Save Changes to refresh the rewrite rules. With plain permalinks, the file is served at /?botgate_llms=1.

Which content is included in llms.txt?

Only the pages and categories you select, and only published content that is not password-protected or private.
